summary: This bill changes the legal definition of 'showerhead' under the Energy Policy and Conservation Act to match the ASME A112.18.1-2024 standard (excluding safety showers) and directs the Department of Energy to update its water-efficiency regulations within 180 days.

scores.thoughts: This bill directly addresses water efficiency regulations by redefining 'showerhead,' which impacts water conservation efforts. By adopting a definition that could potentially allow for less water-efficient showerheads, it moves away from stricter environmental protection in this specific area.
